tasks.analysis: The best method for dating a surface uses radioactivity, the process by which certain elements decay over time. One collects rocks from the surface and measures their radioactive elements to see how much of the decay products have accumulated in the rock since it formed. Transferring this age to the age of the surface can be tricky unless one knows where the rock came from.
